_note: GP's good/bad values and phrasing come from the plan documents' worked example. SS and NA are illustrative placeholders in the same spirit — swap in real judge outputs before publishing.

good.label: Fully sensible

bad.label: Severe violation
bad.note: Element selection is largely arbitrary and contradicts the diagram's hierarchy.

good.label: Well aligned and informative

bad.label: Severe flaws
